text: ポケモンの　ちしき　だったら　ぼくは　まけないと　おもうぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　ちしき　だったら
ぼくは　まけないと　おもうぞ！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: だったら after a thing-word means 'if it's that, when it comes to that'. ちしき　だったら = 'when it comes to knowledge'.

patterns.name: 〜とおもう
patterns.span: まけないと　おもう
patterns.explanation: A plain statement plus と　おもう means 'I think that'. まけないと　おもう = 'I think I won't lose'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, manly talk that gives a statement extra punch. おもうぞ = 'I think so, I tell you!'
